name: allows the first event for each independent message
input: interleaved events for two message keys
test:
logger = MessageCooldownLogger()
assert [
    logger.should_print(1, 'refresh'),
    logger.should_print(3, 'index'),
    logger.should_print(7, 'refresh'),
    logger.should_print(13, 'refresh'),
    logger.should_print(13, 'index'),
] == [True, True, False, True, True]

name: suppressed calls do not reset the cooldown clock
input: one allowed message followed by a rejected attempt and a boundary retry
test:
logger = MessageCooldownLogger()
assert logger.should_print(10, 'snapshot') is True
assert logger.should_print(15, 'snapshot') is False
assert logger.should_print(20, 'snapshot') is True

name: handles same-time duplicate calls and the exact ten-second boundary
input: two same-time calls followed by one boundary call
test:
logger = MessageCooldownLogger()
assert logger.should_print(5, 'event') is True
assert logger.should_print(5, 'event') is False
assert logger.should_print(14, 'event') is False
assert logger.should_print(15, 'event') is True
